gaps.title: Executable Q5-02 permutation probe is missing
gaps.evidence: Q5-02 held-out JSONL has 12 rows and 24 candidate-order permutations with stable expected labels, but no focused report-only runner was found that executes the loaded SkillSelection checkpoint across those permutations.
gaps.required_repair: Create or run a bounded report-only probe that loads the existing SkillSelection checkpoint and evaluates every Q5-02 row/permutation through the production decision path without training or model mutation.
gaps.acceptance_gate: Probe report records per-row/permutation selected skills, rejected skills, evidence features, confidence, RequiresSecondPass, exact expected comparison, first-position baseline, candidate-position-weight baseline, no over-select-all assertion, and semantic_quality_claimed=false.

gaps.title: Model decision stability is not proven
gaps.evidence: The current review can prove expected selected/rejected labels are order-stable, but cannot prove the model emits the same semantic decision across permutations.
gaps.required_repair: After the executable probe exists, rerun Q5-04 review and compare model outputs across the original and permuted candidate orders for each held-out row.
gaps.acceptance_gate: For every held-out row, model selected/rejected sets are invariant under candidate-order permutation and do not contain CandidatePositionScaffoldEvidence as final authority.

gaps.title: Model-vs-candidate-position ablation is not executable evidence yet
gaps.evidence: Artifact-level control shows candidate-position weight index 0 is wrong on 24/24 permutations, but no executable report compares this control against actual model decisions on Q5-02.
gaps.required_repair: The same bounded probe must compute first-position and persisted candidate-position-weight baselines and compare them with model outputs.
gaps.acceptance_gate: Candidate-position control fails or degrades versus model outputs on Q5-02 held-out tasks, with row-level evidence and no semantic-quality overclaim.

gaps.title: Executable probe shows model output does not match Q5-02 expected selected/rejected sets
gaps.evidence: Probe ran 12 held-out rows and 24 candidate-order permutations through the loaded SkillSelectionMachine. Decisions were permutation-stable, no over-select-all occurred, and candidate-position scaffold evidence was not used, but exact expected selected-set matches were 0/24 and expected rejected wrong skills were present for only 12/24 permutations.
gaps.required_repair: Repair SkillSelection model behavior or decision aggregation so Q5-02 held-out rows return the expected small multi-skill selected set and reject the expected wrong-skill near misses without candidate-position authority.
gaps.acceptance_gate: Rerun artifacts/smart-skills-quality-uplift/q5/skill-selection-candidate-position-executable-probe-report.json and require model_selected_expected_exact_set=PASS, model_rejected_expected_wrong_skills=PASS, permutation_stability=PASS, no_over_select_all=PASS, semantic_quality_claimed=false, and no_training_or_model_mutation unless a separate training work order authorizes model mutation.

exact_next_action: Q5-04 parent review rerun with executable probe PASS evidence; Q5-05 wrong-skill near-miss review only after parent review accepts Q5-04.
